description:
The Airness rules that need what only the compiler knows: resolved types, the overload a call
        selected, the members a type inherits, and where a value flows. Each rule is an Error Prone check,
        so it runs inside the compilation every module already performs and reads the trees and symbols
        javac has attributed, rather than parsing the sources a second time.

        The checks reach a build on the annotation processor path, where Error Prone discovers them, and
        never on a compile classpath. Rules that need only the shape of the source live in the Checkstyle
        configuration in airness-config instead.
